_meta.indication: Beleodaq is indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsed or refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL), approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and duration of response

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, single-arm, non-randomized international trial conducted at 62 centers
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with relapsed or refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL); median 2 prior systemic therapies (range 1-8)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: overall response rate (complete response and partial response) assessed by an independent review committee using the International Workshop Criteria; key secondary endpoint duration of response
pivotal_trials.result: Overall response rate 25.8% (31/120; 95% CI 18.3-34.6); CR 10.8% (13/120); PR 15.0% (18/120); median duration of response 8.4 months (95% CI 4.5-29.4)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (All Grades, N=129): nausea 42%, fatigue 37%, pyrexia 35%, anemia 32%, vomiting 29%. Most frequent Grade 3/4 TEAEs included anemia (11%), thrombocytopenia (7%). Nine patients (7%) died as a result of adverse events during or within 30 days of last dose.
target_moa: Histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor; inhibits removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues of histones and some non-histone proteins, causing accumulation of acetylated histones and inducing cell cycle arrest and/or apoptosis of transformed cells

advisory_committee.vote: Not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because the CLN-19 protocol was under a Special Protocol Assessment agreement, the Division was familiar with the trial design and endpoints, and agreement on the Post-Marketing Requirement was reached before review completion

surrogate_endpoint.text: Tumor response rate and duration of response

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and duration of response [see *Clinical Studies* (14)]. An improvement in survival or disease-related symptoms has not been established. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in the confirmatory trial.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Confirmatory, prospective randomized (1:1:1) trial in previously untreated PTCL patients of belinostat plus CHOP vs pralatrexate plus CHOP vs CHOP alone, with PFS as the primary efficacy endpoint (PMR 2178-2)

citations.quote: PMR 2178-2 Characterize the comparative efficacy and safety of belinostat when used in combination with a treatment regimen such as CHOP, versus the combination of pralatrexate plus CHOP, versus CHOP alone for the initial therapy of patients with PTCL. Perform a confirmatory, prospective randomized (1:1:1) trial of previously untreated patients with PTCL, with progression free survival (PFS) as the primary efficacy endpoint.

orphan_indication.text: Belinostat has been granted Orphan Drug status for PTCL

citations.quote: N/A. Belinostat has been granted Orphan Drug status for PTCL.

summary.text: Belinostat (Beleodaq) received accelerated approval under 21 CFR 314.500 for relapsed or refractory PTCL based on tumor response rate and duration of response from the single-arm CLN-19 trial, with a required confirmatory randomized trial (PMR 2178-2); the drug had been granted Orphan Drug status for PTCL.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-1: Establish the optimal and safe dose of belinostat in combination with CHOP; perform a Phase 1 dose finding trial of belinostat plus CHOP for treatment of patients with PTCL

citations.quote: PMR 2178-1 Establish the optimal and safe dose of belinostat in combination with the cyclophosphamide/vincristine/doxorubicin/prednisone (CHOP) regimen. Perform a Phase 1 dose finding trial of belinostat plus CHOP for the treatment of patients with peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL). Enroll a sufficient number of patients to characterize the safety of belinostat in combination with the CHOP regimen

requirement.text: PMR 2178-2: Confirmatory, prospective randomized (1:1:1) trial in previously untreated PTCL patients of belinostat plus CHOP vs pralatrexate plus CHOP vs CHOP alone, with progression free survival (PFS) as primary endpoint

citations.quote: PMR 2178-2 Characterize the comparative efficacy and safety of belinostat when used in combination with a treatment regimen such as CHOP, versus the combination of pralatrexate plus CHOP, versus CHOP alone for the initial therapy of patients with PTCL. Perform a confirmatory, prospective randomized (1:1:1) trial of previously untreated patients with PTCL, with progression free survival (PFS) as the primary efficacy endpoint.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-3: In vitro study to determine contributions of UGT1A1, CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2A6 in the biotransformation of belinostat

citations.quote: PMR 2178-3 Conduct an *in vitro* study to determine the exact contributions of UGT1A1, CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2A6 in the biotransformation of belinostat to evaluate the potential for higher drug exposure or metabolism to a potentially more toxic metabolite. Submit a complete final report with all supporting datasets.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-4: Characterize the mass balance information for Beleodaq; submit final clinical trial report for ongoing human mass balance trial (Protocol SPI-BEL-12-103)

citations.quote: PMR 2178-4 Characterize the mass balance information for Beleodaq. Submit the final clinical trial report for the ongoing human mass balance trial (Protocol SPI-BEL-12-103) designed to evaluate the excretion route of belinostat in humans. Excretion alterations could lead to increased toxicity. Submit a complete final report with all supporting datasets.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-5: Characterize the PK of belinostat in the presence of strong UGT1A1 inhibitors in patients with cancer

citations.quote: PMR 2178-5 Characterize the PK of belinostat in the presence of strong UGT1A1 inhibitors. Conduct a clinical trial evaluating the influence of strong UGT1A1 inhibitors on the pharmacokinetics of belinostat in patients with cancer. Submit a complete final report with all supporting datasets.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-6: Evaluate the safety and pharmacokinetics of belinostat in patients with wild-type, heterozygous, and homozygous UGT1A1*28 genotypes

citations.quote: PMR 2178-6 Evaluate the safety and pharmacokinetics of belinostat in patients with wild-type, heterozygous, and homozygous UGT1A1*28 genotypes. The evaluations should be conducted for sufficient duration and in a sufficient number of subjects in order to evaluate safety following multiple dose administration. Submit a complete final report with all supporting datasets.

requirement.text: PMR 2178-7: Characterize the PK and safety of belinostat in the presence of hepatic impairment; submit final report for ongoing hepatic impairment trial (Protocol CTEP #8846)

citations.quote: PMR 2178-7 Characterize the PK and safety of belinostat in the presence of hepatic impairment. Submit the final clinical trial report for the ongoing hepatic impairment trial (Protocol CTEP #8846) that is designed to evaluate the influence of hepatic impairment on the PK and safety of belinostat. Submit a complete final report with all supporting datasets.
